name: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System
description: An international standard specifying requirements for a quality management system. Organizations are audited against 10 clauses covering context, leadership, planning, support, operations, and improvement.
reputation: Most widely certified management standard globally; 1.1M+ certificates in 180+ countries.
notes: Third-party audit required for certification; compliance ≠ performance; gaming through paper compliance.
